input.spec:
Audit pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 (branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) in repository oakridge. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not feature work: its only purpose is real analysis, plan, brief, build_result and assessment artifacts for observation to capture and grade. The analysis reports at least three separate findings about this spec, each a distinct observation. Produce exactly three tasks and exactly two cohorts, named alpha and beta, neither depending on the other. T1: a composite counts each finding once per task and keeps stages apart (observation/src/grading/composite.ts). T2: a declaration is journaled only after its exact tasks revision is approved (oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts). T3: a drilldown's nested lists page separately (observation/src/grading/composite.ts). Cohort alpha carries T1 and T2. Cohort beta carries T1 and T3. T1 is the same task in both cohorts, under the same id.
The operator authorizes this audit path: each builder publishes the existing PR #793 as its pr artifact instead of pushing or opening one. No brief may add a further operator choice or confirmation. Each builder must not edit files, create commits, push, open or update any pull request, merge, reset a database or deploy. Its worktree starts from epic/grade-pray, the base of pull request #793, so it first checks out the head of branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e locally (git checkout --detach origin/cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e) and inspects that commit, runs bun install if needed and then bun run --filter observation test once, and publishes build_result with the commit it inspected as head_sha and the actual test counts and output. A test that cannot run is a known issue, never a reason to invent results. It then publishes the existing pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/793 as the pr artifact, with branch cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e.
Each assessor assesses that same commit without changing anything. Give at least one finding per task of its cohort, naming that task id. Every finding cites at least one file as path:start-end at that commit, for example observation/src/grading/composite.ts:20-40, and cites test output separately as test or output evidence. Report the builder's test run as test_evidence.
Keep the spec, tasks, plan and briefs short; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve.

body.summary: The audit is implementable without an operator decision. PR #793 is open at head 100000b53ad4012df9c2074953ad2199adcc312b on cohort/task-lineage-composites/ba9a7e against epic/grade-pray, and the local refs match. Repository code and tests directly support the shared-task topology and T1-T3 behavior. Two non-blocking verification gaps should be corrected: the mandated observation-only test command does not execute T2's oakridge-dbos tests, and DB-backed observation composite tests are skipped when OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is absent (as it is in this workspace).

findings.description: The requested topology is representable without duplicating T1: workflow-config/development.yaml:276-283 validates an acyclic cohort graph, requires every approved task in at least one cohort, enforces uniqueness only within a cohort, and explicitly permits the same task id in another cohort. Thus exactly three task records and alpha/beta with empty depends_on lists can carry T1 in both cohorts as specified.

T1 matches the target implementation. observation/src/grading/composite.ts:147-158 selects each occurrence once when any matching edge reaches the task, while observation/src/grading/composite.ts:314-366 filters and counts independently per stage. observation/tests/composite.test.ts:198-218 covers one logical task shared across alpha and beta, observation/tests/composite.test.ts:238-260 proves stages remain separate, and observation/tests/composite.test.ts:348-362 proves duplicate paths still count one item.

T2 is implemented and tested, but the specified builder command does not run its tests. oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:758-784 locks the run, checks an approve decision for the exact tasks revision, then journals; oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts:797-804 atomically couples approval and supplied links. The behavioral coverage is oakridge-dbos/tests/analysis-link-declaration.test.ts:66-121 and :204-277, classified as integration by oakridge-dbos/tests/run-suite.sh:12-20. `bun run --filter observation test` invokes only observation/package.json's test script, so its output cannot substantiate T2.

The mandated observation command may complete while skipping the DB-backed T1/T3 evidence. observation/tests/grading-fixture.ts:21-22 maps integration tests to test.skip unless OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is set (or CI is true), and the key composite cases in observation/tests/composite.test.ts are integration tests. OAKRIDGE_TEST_DATABASE_URL is currently unset in this workspace. A skipped case must be reported as not run/known issue, not counted as passing evidence.

T3 matches the target implementation. observation/src/grading/composite.ts:419-455 defines separate windows for rows, questions, links, statuses, current answers, and superseded answers, applies each window only to its own list, and reports total before slicing. observation/tests/composite.test.ts:393-442 independently advances those nested windows and verifies totals and list isolation.

requirements.description: Audit that a composite counts each finding occurrence once per logical task and keeps analysis, implementation, and integration stages separate in observation/src/grading/composite.ts.

Audit that an analysis-link declaration is journaled only against its exact approved tasks revision in oakridge-dbos/src/storage/commit.ts; relevant DBOS test output should be added to the audit evidence.
Audit that drilldown rows and every nested list paginate with independent windows and complete totals in observation/src/grading/composite.ts.

decisions_made.rationale: This unit is an isolated verification of the committed development definition. Fixes, retries that obscure the prescribed runs, invented results, and local or remote implementation changes would invalidate the audit evidence and exceed the authorized path.

decisions_made.decision: Evaluate composite finding contributions once per logical task while preserving analysis, implementation, and integration as separate stage composites.
decisions_made.rationale: The shared T1 obligation concerns task identity rather than duplicate finding occurrences, but stage identity remains semantically significant and must not be collapsed.

decisions_made.decision: Evaluate every composite drilldown collection using its own offset and limit and retain the complete unpaged total for each collection.
decisions_made.rationale: Drilldown rows and nested lists are distinct collections; sharing a page window or reporting only page length would make one collection's navigation distort another's results and totals.

decisions_made.decision: Evaluate analysis-link declaration journaling against approval of the exact tasks revision within the same durable commit boundary, including refusal before exact approval, idempotent replay behavior, and rollback when the durable commit fails.
decisions_made.rationale: The declaration must never become durable from approval of a different revision or from a partially completed transaction; refusal, replay, and rollback establish that the approval check and journal write share one authoritative boundary.
